claims.quote: Pathogenic variants in STXBP1 cause a spectrum of disorders mainly consisting of developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE), often featuring drug-resistant epilepsy.
We estimated a mortality rate of 3.2% (31/966), based on the STXBP1 Foundation and the STXBP1 Global Connect registry.
